message.content: Now the minimal SKILL.md usage-note updates (claim contract, needs-OCR state, raw-text retention).

function.name: apply_patch
function.arguments:
{"input":"*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /workspace/outputs/skill/SKILL.md
@@
 Each result carries a content-hash `candidate_id` and per-page text, so renamed files and multi-PDF batches never mix candidates. Exit codes: 0 all extracted, 2 all failed, 3 partial.
 
 **Stop on explicit errors.** `file not found` / `empty file (0 bytes)` / `corrupt/unopenable PDF` / zero pages are reported as errors, never fabricated into an empty success. Tell the user which files failed and why; do not guess at their content. If a PDF has no extractable text layer (scanned image), say so and fall back to OCR/vision separately — do not silently return an empty page.
+
+**Image-only PDFs are an explicit unusable state.** A scanned/image-only PDF is reported as `no usable text layer (scanned image; needs OCR)`; it is never a quiet empty success. Exit codes stay: all files unusable → 2, mixed usable + unusable → 3 (good candidates keep their own identity). Run OCR/vision separately for those files; the script adds no OCR engine. Each page also carries `raw_text` (unfiltered page text); the resume-platform watermark heuristic only filters the display `text`/`lines`, so legitimate evidence is never erased from the record.
@@
 `claims.json` is a JSON array: `[{"file": "cv.pdf", "page": 2, "quote": "exact text from that CV"}]`. Quotes are whitespace-normalized, so line breaks inside a PDF quote are fine. The checker fails (exit 2) on: quote absent, quote on a different page than claimed, out-of-range page, or any file-level extraction error — and reports the page(s) where the quote actually is. Fix the report before delivering.
+
+Claim contract (checked before extraction): each item must be a JSON object; `file` and `quote` must be nonempty strings; `page` is optional and must be a positive JSON integer — `true`, `2.0`, `"2"` and `0` are rejected. Contract violations fail with exit 2 and a per-claim `index`/`field`/`reason` diagnostic, never a traceback.
*** End Patch
"}
